scope: Finite fixture/menu/style/empty-field/cold/live-size assertion source review; root independently reviews observer mechanics. External controller is not implemented or admitted by this review.

finding.detail: Expanded matchesOne(nominal:false) requires each run to have the correct face/traits and a positive size, while fontsAreLarger compares only primaryFont. A partially refreshed heading/code with an enlarged first run and a later unchanged-size run could satisfy the current expanded assertion.
finding.requestedNarrowCorrection: Require every expanded font run to exceed the already-qualified nominal baseline size for that block; use typingFont for the empty paragraph. Existing complete UTF16 coverage/style checks remain.

otherObservations: Nine menu labels and native type/level/ordered/number/checked fields agree with the separately published catalog; the representative UIKit before-menu insertion retains exact order and visible geometry checks.

The original writing policy resolves natural alignment by application language, with explicit RTL applied separately. Empty-field assertions require zero native/rendered text and actual mounted typing attributes.
Nine small documents retain the original complete-visible snapshot requirement and 24KiB output limit; no partial-render acceptance is introduced.
Cold readback retains native object/block identity, complete style JSON and text/markers and requires a different App PID within the owned account/Space.

Live-size readback requires one App PID, native generation/version, Space/object/blocks/text and selection to remain identical. Actual mounted category and font observations remain mandatory despite the controller response.

No additional concrete blocker found in the reviewed fixture/semantics scope. App/runner source admission, simulator settings restoration, raw attachment qualification and visual review remain explicit future requirements.
